scenes.visual: Centered serif statement with italic follow-up emphasis.

scenes.voice: We pay taxes for basic services. Public officials should answer to the people they serve.
scenes.visual: Taxes and public accountability. Landing-page horizon and typography.

scenes.voice: A complaint number isn't a repair. Getting answers still means calls, reminders, and time most citizens cannot spare.
scenes.visual: Complaint number versus a completed repair. Word Stream shows calls, reminders and waiting; no invented statistics.

scenes.voice: So we built Pramanik: an autonomous accountability office of AI agents.
scenes.visual: Pramanik wordmark and blue depth pill introduce the autonomous office.

scenes.voice: Agents bring related reports together, identify duplicates, and build one shared case with locations, photos, and earlier conversations.
scenes.visual: Zoom into citizen report → grouping/de-duplication → shared case. Locations, evidence and history remain connected.

scenes.voice: Specialists work in parallel. They review reports, remember past promises, and check responsibility. GPT reasoning helps the coordinator turn their findings into a plan.
scenes.visual: One coordinator dispatches to three specialist paths concurrently. Independent results join into an action plan. Entrances are staggered; actual work packets start together.

scenes.voice: Using public ward directories, the office identifies the responsible officer or local representative and their contact details.
scenes.visual: Zoom to action plan → ward contact. Public ward directories, role and responsibility guide contact lookup.

scenes.voice: We gave agents a voice and a real phone number through Bolna. GPT Realtime powers conversations in Hindi, Marathi, and English. The agent calls with context and asks for action.
scenes.visual: Zoom to voice agent and responsible officer. Hindi, Marathi and English labels; real phone-number provisioning through Bolna. No invented officer dialogue or call audio.

scenes.voice: Every answer and promised date becomes part of the case's memory. Background jobs bring it back for review and the next follow-up.
scenes.visual: Evaluate the response, save promises/dates, and activate the persistent worker. A narrow curved path carries follow-up data back to the voice agent.

scenes.voice: An officer saying done isn't enough. A public survey asks affected residents, including the people who complained, for observations and photos.
scenes.visual: Completion claim → public survey for affected residents → photos and observations.

scenes.voice: AI helps compare the evidence with the claim, alongside human review. If the ground tells a different story, the case reopens. The agent calls again with every earlier promise.
scenes.visual: AI-assisted evidence comparison and human review. Conditional verified exit; conflicting evidence follows a shallow return loop to the worker and another call.

scenes.voice: Calls, promises, evidence, and next steps stay in a public record, so everyone can question progress and verify the result.
scenes.visual: Zoom out to the entire single-page graph. Calls, promises, evidence and next steps are a public accountability record.

scenes.voice: Basic services should not require endless chasing. You report the problem. We keep following up. Pramanik.
scenes.visual: Landing-page closing: You report the problem. We keep following up. Serif/italic hierarchy, blue pill and brand horizon.
